no-column-shallow.basis: Gravity-only, simply supported members with explicit reaction transfer. No continuity credit. All floor patches, supports and actual point-load stations are listed. Section choices are conditional screens, not issued member sizes.
no-column-shallow.scope: Floor load budgets include timber structure, finishes, ceilings/services and assumed lightweight partitions. Rolled-beam self-weight is additional. Roof, masonry, concentrated floor loads, baths/storage, lateral stability, support settlement and all connections, columns, bearing walls and foundations are not verified. The gallery cantilever bearing reaction is exported, not designed in this comparison.
